data.essence: A living venture made legible: organic continuity held inside calm, evidence-bearing boundaries.

principles: Asymmetric editorial fields with generous negative space
One copper consequence marker per composition
Organic viable regions paired with precise evidence rails
Visible layers that retain history instead of erasing it

forbidden_visuals: Neon AI gradients, glassmorphism, and black cyberpunk dashboards
Friendly robot employees, glowing brains, and particle swarms
Literal tree logos, decorative leaf repetition, and infinity symbols
Controllers, trophies, scoreboards, and other finite-game victory clichés
Generated interface imagery presented as evidence of a live product

visual_principles.name: Growth keeps its rings
visual_principles.description: New information is added as a visible layer; it does not erase history. Use nested contours, dated marks, and restrained palimpsest effects.

visual_principles.name: Boundaries are information
visual_principles.description: A limit is drawn clearly and calmly. Safe trajectories bend inward; gates appear as deliberate human interventions, not alarms.

visual_principles.name: One consequence at a time
visual_principles.description: Every composition has one copper focal point representing the current consequential choice. Everything else supports orientation.

visual_principles.name: Evidence has texture
visual_principles.description: Use paper grain, bark fiber, pencil lines, stamped labels, and quiet instrument marks so provenance feels physical and inspectable.

visual_principles.name: Dormancy is not emptiness
visual_principles.description: Negative space communicates a system at rest and ready. Avoid filling silence with dashboards, particles, or constant motion.

style.lighting: Soft northern-window daylight or overcast natural light; gentle falloff; no neon rim light or glossy tech studio treatment.
style.composition: Editorial wide frames with quiet negative space, one human trace, and tactile foreground detail. Prefer asymmetric balance and layers that suggest time.
style.color_treatment: Warm-muted filmic color, restrained saturation, deep lichen shadows, bone highlights, and occasional copper-brown material accents.
style.subject_focus: The steward's environment, instruments, notebooks, garden/workshop metaphors, and the evidence of a decision; avoid staring founder portraits and screens as the only subject.
style.mood: Calm vigilance, earned relief, continuity, patience, and quiet competence.
style.context: Real small-business workspaces, gardens, workshops, studios, and threshold moments before or after a bounded decision.

references: A founder's desk after dawn: ledger open, tea cooling, screen asleep, one copper pencil mark.
Macro botanical study of the thin living layer beneath bark, scientifically plausible but poetic.
A small workshop prepared for work yet momentarily empty, showing continuity without busyness.
Overhead arrangement of receipts, field notes, and one clean operating instrument.
photography.prompt_template: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: {asset}. Scene: {real founder or small-business environment}. Subject: {one evidence-bearing human trace or instrument}. Style: quiet editorial documentary photograph with natural material texture. Composition: {framing} with generous negative space. Lighting: soft northern-window or overcast daylight. Palette: warm-muted, deep lichen #1F3A2E, bone #F4EFE3, small copper #B76E3F accent. Mood: calm vigilance and continuity. Constraints: no robots, no holograms, no neon, no purple AI gradient, no stock-photo handshake, no legible private data, no logos, no text, no watermark.

style.type: editorial line art with scientific-field-guide discipline
style.complexity: medium: one focal metaphor, three to seven supporting marks
style.line_weight: variable 1.5–3px equivalent; organic outer contour with precise instrument annotations
style.color_approach: Living Lichen line work on Bone, New Growth fills for safe regions, one Cambium Copper decision mark; no gradients
style.character_style: Humans appear as partial gestures or small steward figures, never mascots, avatars, or synthetic employee portraits.

illustration.prompt_template: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: {surface}. Primary request: visualize {concept} as a living-systems field-guide plate. Medium: precise editorial ink line art with subtle paper grain. Composition: one strong central metaphor, ample whitespace, a few instrument-like annotations without text. Palette: #1F3A2E, #7E9B63, #B76E3F on #F4EFE3. Constraints: no gradients, no robots, no brains, no game controller, no fantasy tree, no corporate vector people, no text, no watermark.

iconography.style: monoline with one optional copper state notch
iconography.stroke_weight: 1.75px at 24px; optical correction allowed at joins
iconography.corner_radius: 2px geometric corners softened by one-quarter stroke width

patterns.type: non-repeating contour-field pattern derived from growth rings and viable trajectories
patterns.scale: large and sparse: one contour interval every 48–96px at common display sizes
patterns.prompt_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless or wide brand pattern. Primary request: sparse contour lines inspired by tree growth rings and phase-space trajectories, with paths gently bending inward near a boundary. Flat line art, generous negative space, #1F3A2E and #7E9B63 on #F4EFE3, one rare #B76E3F notch. No text, gradients, leaves, topographic-map labels, infinity symbols, glow, or watermark.

layout_language.grid: Twelve-column editorial grid on desktop, four-column mobile; evidence rail may occupy two columns.
layout_language.spacing: Use an 8px base rhythm with 24/40/64/104px narrative intervals.
layout_language.shapes: Soft irregular ovals for viable regions; hairline rules and squared receipt cards for evidence; never pill-everything UI.
layout_language.motion: Slow state transitions that begin and end at rest; animate a path only when showing a real wake or replay.

do: Pair organic boundaries with precise evidence labels.
Use one copper focal point per composition.
Show continuation through layering rather than arrows or speed lines.
Let empty space communicate dormancy and readiness.
Label generated visuals as illustrative, not product proof.
dont: Do not use neon AI gradients, glassmorphism, particle swarms, or black cyberpunk dashboards.
Do not depict teams of friendly AI employee avatars.
Do not make a literal tree logo or repeat leaf motifs decoratively.
Do not confuse infinite game with gaming, controllers, trophies, or scoreboards.
Do not use generated interface imagery as evidence of a live product.

data.asset_label: Illustrative — generated brand expression, not product proof
